message: I was chatting with my friend Carol the other day about our emergency plans, and bless her heart, she always seems to spiral into panic mode. 😅 She asked me what I’d do if a big storm hit, and instead of worrying, I shared my little go-bag routine and how I keep my important documents handy. It made me realize that a bit of preparation can turn anxiety into peace of mind. Have you ever found yourself calming a friend’s worries with your own plans?
